title: Reduced Relative & Participle Clauses: Syntactic Economy
subtitle: CEFR C1–C2 • Active (-ing) vs. Passive (-ed/V3) Clause Compression

topics.title: 1. Active Participle Reduction (Replacing 'Who/Which + Verb' with V-ing)
topics.subtitle: Streamlining Active Descriptions & Simultaneous Actions
topics.explanation: Ketika relative pronoun (who, which, that) menjadi subjek dari kata kerja AKTIF, kita dapat menghapus pronoun tersebut dan mengubah kata kerjanya menjadi Present Participle (V-ing)—berlaku untuk semua tenses!
topics.rationale: Menghapus kata penghubung yang berulang ('developers who work...', 'services which run...') membuat kalimat panjang terasa lincah, padat, dan setara tulisan jurnal atau buku teknis.

formulas.pattern: [Noun] + [V-ing Phrase] + Main Verb  (replaces: Noun + who/which + Active Verb)
Did you inspect the process [consuming / running] + Object?

conditionalExamples.positive: Microservices handling payment transactions require strict idempotency.
conditionalExamples.negative: Users not complying with the rate limit will receive a 429 status.
conditionalExamples.question: Who is the engineer leading the frontend architecture migration?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Microservices handling...' adalah bentuk ringkas dari 'Microservices which handle...'.

xrayTokens.nuance: Meringkas 'which handle payment transactions' menjadi satu frasa padat

specialExceptions.title: Waspadai Dangling Participle (Subjek Klausa Harus Sama!)
specialExceptions.explanation: Jika participle diletakkan di awal kalimat, subjek setelah koma HARUS merupakan pelaku dari V-ing tersebut.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: Running the build script, an unexpected syntax error appeared. (Bukan error yang menjalankan script!)
specialExceptions.correctExample: Running the build script, I encountered an unexpected syntax error.

tipsAndTricks: Setiap kali melihat 'which + V1/V2' dalam tulisanmu, coba hapus 'which' dan ubah kata kerjanya ke V-ing—kalimatmu langsung naik satu level.

topics.title: 2. Passive Participle Reduction (Replacing 'Which + Be + V3' with Bare V3)
topics.subtitle: Compact Post-Nominal Modifiers with Past Participles
topics.explanation: Ketika relative clause berbentuk PASIF ('the data which was encrypted', 'the guidelines that are outlined'), kita cukup menghapus 'which/that + to be' dan menyisakan Verb-3 langsung di belakang kata benda.
topics.rationale: Pola ini adalah standar mutlak dalam spesifikasi teknis, abstrak penelitian, dan kontrak hukum karena menghemat kata tanpa mengurangi ketepatan makna sedikit pun.

formulas.pattern: [Noun] + [Verb-3 Phrase] + Main Verb  (replaces: Noun + which/that + be + V3)
Where is the payload [sent / generated] by the webhook?

conditionalExamples.positive: All metrics collected during the benchmark are stored in PostgreSQL.
conditionalExamples.negative: Packages not listed in the lockfile will be rejected by CI.
conditionalExamples.question: Have you reviewed the architecture diagram attached to the ticket?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Metrics collected' = 'metrics that were collected'; 'diagram attached' = 'diagram that is attached'.

xrayTokens.nuance: Menghapus 'which were' sehingga langsung menempel pada 'metrics'

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Mengacaukan V-ing (Aktif) dan V3 (Pasif) Setelah Kata Benda
specialExceptions.explanation: Jika benda melakukan aksi → V-ing (the script running on port 3000). Jika benda dikenai aksi → V3 (the script written in Python).
specialExceptions.wrongExample: The email sending yesterday contained the invoice.
specialExceptions.correctExample: The email sent yesterday contained the invoice.

tipsAndTricks: Tes Aktif vs. Pasif: 'Email dikirim' (pasif → sent), 'Server berjalan' (aktif → running).

scenario.intent: Menjelaskan bahwa token yang dihasilkan oleh server berlaku selama 1 jam.

practiceQuiz.question: Pilih kalimat dengan bentuk Reduced Relative Clause yang benar:

options.text: Tokens generating by the auth server expire after one hour.
Tokens generated by the auth server expire after one hour.
Tokens are generated by the auth server expire after one hour.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: Karena token 'dihasilkan' (pasif), reduksi dari 'Tokens which are generated' menjadi 'Tokens generated'.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A memakai bentuk aktif (-ing), dan Opsi C menyisakan 'are' tanpa 'which' sehingga menciptakan dua kata kerja utama.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Jika ada kata 'by [agent]' di belakangnya, 99% itu adalah bentuk pasif sehingga memakai Verb-3.
